module: Vehicle Editor helper to move the selected nodes (vEditor.selectedNodes) with the editor's axis gizmo. The gizmo is centered on the average of the node positions; during the drag, each node receives its original position plus the delta (in local coordinates, sign inverted).
notes: transformNodes() must be called every frame as long as nodes are selected; it divides by #vEditor.selectedNodes without checking that it is non-zero (division by 0 -> inf/NaN if the selection is empty).
Disables the plane, the hatching and the translation grid of the gizmo (worldEditorCppApi.setAxisGizmoRender*) when not dragging.
The gizmo is in local alignment (editor.AxisGizmoAlignment_Local), identity orientation.

transformNodes.desc: Places and draws the gizmo at the center of the selected nodes, handles start/end/drag and applies the offset to the nodes (node.pos).

returns.desc: true if a gizmo drag is in progress during this call.
